messages:
Dana (oncall): IncidentBot paged me for elevated tail latency on generation in us-east-1. Can we draft a short public note? Need scope, impact, and that we're working on it.
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 2065439999 - Increased p99 latency detected for /v1/generate (us-east-1). Pager: Dana.
Liam (SRE): Im looking. Seeing CPU contention and pod restarts on a few nodes; may be autoscaler thrash. Kicking off node reprovisions.
Rosa (runtime): No recent model pushes. Checking KV cache hit-rate and memory pressure. Sending recent heap and cache stats.
Jules (product): Quick ask: do we expect request errors or just slowness? Need to advise customers.
Liam (SRE): So far it's latency only, occasional 524s on very long requests. No evidence of mispredictions or data loss.
Hannah (comms): I can put together a status page blurb. Proposal: one-sentence impact, scope (hosted region), guidance (retry/backoff), ETA for next update.
Dana (oncall): Please call out if Dedicated/Private customers are impacted. I'll do the internal incident doc link.
Hannah (comms): Draft v1: ```We are investigating increased response times for the text generation API in the us-east-1 region. Some requests may take longer than usual. Our engineers are actively investigating. Next update in 30 minutes.``` Thoughts?
Rosa (runtime): Add that there is no ongoing data loss. Also mention were scaling reprovisions.
Hannah (comms): Updated: ```Customers may experience increased latency for the /v1/generate endpoint in us-east-1. There is no data loss expected. We are reprovisioning affected workers and monitoring performance. Next update in 30 minutes.```
Liam (SRE): Recommend adding scope line: Hosted API only; Dedicated/Private unaffected.
Hannah (comms): Added scope line. New draft ready to publish after ops sign-off.
IncidentBot: [UPDATE] 2065440015 - 2 nodes reprovisioned; p90 improving, p99 still high.
Rosa (runtime): Cache warmup noticed on reprovisioned nodes. p90 ~200ms, p99 ~1.8s. Working on prefill for hot prefixes.
Dana (oncall): Ops: can we run a small warm traffic canary to avoid more cold-start spikes?
Liam (SRE): Yes. I'll enable a rolling warmup and bump the min replicas temporarily. Action: `kubectl patch hpa generation -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'` then trigger warm traffic.
Hannah (comms): Second public update draft: ```Update: We have reprovisioned a subset of workers in us-east-1 and are seeing improved latency for most requests. High tail latency may persist briefly as caches warm. Hosted API in us-east-1 is impacted; Dedicated/Private deployments are unaffected. Engineers continue to monitor.``` Add ETA?
Jules (product): Add estimated time to recover (ETR) for cache warmup, e.g., ~20 minutes.
Hannah (comms): Done: appended "Estimated resolution: ~20 minutes". Ready for publish on confirmation.
Liam (SRE): Ops thumbs-up. Publishing now. Command: ```/publish-status "INC-206544" --component generation-api-us-east-1 --impact degraded --body "Customers may experience increased latency for /v1/generate in us-east-1. No data loss expected. Engineers are reprovisioning workers and warming caches; estimated resolution ~20 minutes."```
IncidentBot: [PUBLISHED] 2065440030 - Status page update published (INC-206544).
Hannah (comms): Posted a brief customer-facing Slack message to #customers-status and added a canned reply for support: "We're aware of increased latency in us-east-1 for hosted generation. No data loss. We're working on mitigation; please retry with backoff."
Rosa (runtime): Monitoring shows steady improvement; prefill helped drop p99 to ~900ms. Leaving warmup traffic running.
Liam (SRE): Opening follow-up items: review autoscaler thresholds, add warmup playbook, assess node replacement timing. Tagging runtime and infra for postmortem.
IncidentBot: [UPDATE] 2065440055 - p99 under 500ms for 5m window.
Dana (oncall): Back from a call. Great work. Prepare resolved note that avoids speculative root cause. Hannah, can you draft resolved copy?
Hannah (comms): Resolved draft: ```Resolved: Performance for the text generation API in us-east-1 has returned to expected levels. The hosted generation endpoint is operating normally. We are continuing to investigate the underlying cause and will publish a post-incident report. If you see any residual issues, contact support. Incident ID: INC-206544. Resolved at 2065440060.``` Approve?
Jules (product): Approve. Include that Dedicated/Private were not affected.
Hannah (comms): Added that line. Ready to publish.
Liam (SRE): Publishing resolved update. Command: ```/publish-status "INC-206544" --action resolved --body "Performance restored for /v1/generate in us-east-1 (resolved at 2065440060). Engineers will follow up with a post-incident report."```
IncidentBot: [RESOLVED] 2065440060 - Status page updated to resolved.
Dana (oncall): Handoff: Liam owns postmortem and autoscaler tweaks; Rosa to investigate cache behavior; Hannah to update incident template with warmup steps and support replies. Closing now. :thumbsup:
Hannah (comms): I'll push the comms snippets into the incident templates and add a short customer FAQ.
Rosa (runtime): I'll submit root-cause ticket and post findings within 72 hours.
Liam (SRE): Added actions to the board and assigned owners. Incident INC-206544 logged.
IncidentBot: [LOGGED] Incident INC-206544 created and assigned.
